title: Reception Desk — white sweeping fascia over a timber cubby wall, with a transaction ledge
description:
A parametric RECEPTION DESK on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE. The visitor faces the −v side: a timber cubby wall rises to the transaction ledge (worktop + ledge rise), and a white fascia sweeps across it from full height at one end down to Sweep low point at the other — a cosine, so it leaves the top and arrives at the floor tangentially. The staff worktop sits behind at worktop height between two white end panels.

DEFAULTS are the INFRA Reception dims sheet (slide 16): 3300 long, 800 deep, 750 worktop, 300 ledge rise.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO: the reference fascia is a doubly-curved solid; this one is a vertical ribbon of flat segments whose top edge follows the curve.

params.name: Reception Desk maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
rdL = length * _s
rdD = depth * _s
rdH = height * _s
rdTop = (height + ledgeRise) * _s
rdLd = ledgeDepth * _s
rdT = topThk * _s
rdF = fasciaThk * _s
rdB = boardThk * _s
rdPl = plinth * _s
_bodyL = rdL
_bodyW = rdD + rdF
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
rdX = rdL / 2
rdY0 = 0 - rdD / 2
rdY1 = rdD / 2
rdYc = rdY0 + rdLd
# Worktop (staff side) and transaction ledge (visitor side) — white
rdWork = hcat(0 - rdX, rdYc, rdX, rdYc, rdX, rdY1, 0 - rdX, rdY1, rdH - rdT, rdH, 1)
rdLedge = hcat(0 - rdX, rdY0 - rdF, rdX, rdY0 - rdF, rdX, rdYc, 0 - rdX, rdYc, rdTop - rdT, rdTop, 1)
rdEnds = vcat(hcat(0 - rdX, rdYc, 0 - rdX + rdT, rdYc, 0 - rdX + rdT, rdY1, 0 - rdX, rdY1, 0, rdH - rdT, 1), hcat(rdX - rdT, rdYc, rdX, rdYc, rdX, rdY1, rdX - rdT, rdY1, 0, rdH - rdT, 1))
# Cubby wall under the ledge — timber: back panel, vertical boards, shelves
rdNc = max(1, round(cubbyCols))
rdNr = max(1, round(cubbyRows))
rdCz0 = rdPl
rdCz1 = rdTop - rdT
rdCw = rdL / rdNc
rdCh = (rdCz1 - rdCz0) / rdNr
rdBack = hcat(0 - rdX, rdYc - rdB, rdX, rdYc - rdB, rdX, rdYc, 0 - rdX, rdYc, rdCz0, rdCz1, 2)
rdVi = arange(rdNc + 1)
rdVu = 0 - rdX + rdVi * rdCw
rdNv = rows(rdVi)
rdVert = hcat(rdVu - rdB / 2, fill(rdNv, 1, rdY0), rdVu + rdB / 2, fill(rdNv, 1, rdY0), rdVu + rdB / 2, fill(rdNv, 1, rdYc), rdVu - rdB / 2, fill(rdNv, 1, rdYc), fill(rdNv, 1, rdCz0), fill(rdNv, 1, rdCz1), fill(rdNv, 1, 2))
rdHi = arange(rdNr + 1)
rdHz = rdCz0 + rdHi * rdCh
rdNh = rows(rdHi)
rdShelf = hcat(fill(rdNh, 1, 0 - rdX), fill(rdNh, 1, rdY0), fill(rdNh, 1, rdX), fill(rdNh, 1, rdY0), fill(rdNh, 1, rdX), fill(rdNh, 1, rdYc), fill(rdNh, 1, 0 - rdX), fill(rdNh, 1, rdYc), rdHz - rdB / 2, rdHz + rdB / 2, fill(rdNh, 1, 2))
rdPlinth = hcat(0 - rdX, rdY0 + 0.03, rdX, rdY0 + 0.03, rdX, rdYc, 0 - rdX, rdYc, 0, rdPl, 3)
# Sweeping fascia — white, segmented along the length; height follows a cosine from high to low
rdNs = max(4, round(sweepSegments))
rdSi = arange(rdNs)
rdDu = rdL / rdNs
rdSa = 0 - rdX + rdSi * rdDu
rdT01 = (rdSi + 0.5) / rdNs
rdTt = sweep == 'Right high' ? 1 - rdT01 : rdT01
rdShape = sweep == 'Full' ? fill(rdNs, 1, 1) : sweepLow + (1 - sweepLow) * (0.5 + 0.5 * cos(PI * rdTt))
rdFz = max(0.02, rdShape * (rdTop - rdT))
rdFasc = hcat(rdSa, fill(rdNs, 1, rdY0 - rdF), rdSa + rdDu, fill(rdNs, 1, rdY0 - rdF), rdSa + rdDu, fill(rdNs, 1, rdY0), rdSa, fill(rdNs, 1, rdY0), fill(rdNs, 1, 0), rdFz, fill(rdNs, 1, 1))
Q = vcat(rdWork, rdLedge, rdEnds, rdFasc, rdBack, rdVert, rdShelf, rdPlinth)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
White3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Cubbies3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Plinth3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
WhitePlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
CubbiesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
deskLength = rdL
deskDepth = rdD + rdF
worktopHeight = rdH
counterHeight = rdTop
cubbyCount = rdNc * rdNr
cubbyWidth = rdCw - rdB
